harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16.15 and the `branch_stock` database on node1. Least-privilege access, protected credentials on node2, supplied-record preservation, security controls, and persistence across sequential reboots of both nodes were verified.
actions_performed: Installed RHEL-native PostgreSQL server packages on node1 and client packages on node2 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Loaded the supplied stock and supplier_costs records into `branch_stock`.
Granted `stock_app` stock reads and quantity-only updates; denied supplier costs, schema changes, SKU changes, inserts, and deletes.
Granted `auditor` read-only access to stock and supplier_costs.
Stored distinct credentials as root-owned mode-0600 files under `/etc/branch_stock` on node2.
Restricted PostgreSQL to node1's managed IP and allowed port 5432 only from node2 through firewalld.
Retained secured pre-change PostgreSQL configuration copies for rollback and removed temporary test artifacts.
Safely restarted node1 and node2 one at a time, proving changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Deploy branch_stock and preserve supplied records
evidence.summary: The original files retain SHA-256 7934fb042f67368428ae2fcf771fef48d1e6154f8d0d1e6b1c9d144c7d5622ea on both nodes; the database contains LABELS:18, PAPER:40 and costs LABELS:1.75, PAPER:3.25.

evidence.requirement: stock_app reads stock and updates quantities only
evidence.summary: Remote read and rolled-back quantity update succeeded; supplier-cost reads, schema creation, SKU updates, inserts, and deletes were denied, including after both reboots.

evidence.requirement: auditor has read-only access to both tables
evidence.summary: Auditor read both tables while table updates and schema creation were denied, including after both reboots.
Distinct credentials persist in separate root-owned mode-0600 pgpass files on node2.

evidence.requirement: Compatible platform and secured network service
evidence.summary: PostgreSQL 16.15 uses signed RHEL packages; RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1 remain unchanged. SELinux is enforcing, PostgreSQL listens only on node1's managed address, and firewalld limits access to node2.
Healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-... was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID e7b8c7d0-... observed, and PostgreSQL, exact data, firewall policy, and remote role access recovered.
Healthy baseline boot ID 19062a82-... was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 587b9b09-... observed, and credentials plus allowed and denied database behavior recovered.
